meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze bounded FluidSim computational-fluid-dynamics simulations with explicit numerical-validity and HPC safety checks. Use for FluidSim solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, or restart compatibility.

copy.tagline: 配置并校验计算流体仿真,让模拟稳定可靠、安全续跑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在用计算流体仿真做科研数值模拟,需要确认设置准确并安全重启任务
copy.tagline_en: Set up and validate fluid-flow simulations for stable, safe runs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run computational fluid dynamics simulations and need sound setup and safe restarts

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 FluidSim 的 Python 求解器帮你配置并运行流体模拟:设置网格分辨率、黏度、时间步长等参数,启动 2D/3D 纳维-斯托克斯、浅水或分层流模拟,并输出涡度、能谱等结果。
howto.when: 当你要运行流体模拟、挑选求解器或检查数值参数时触发,也会处理 FFT/MPI 配置与输出诊断。

howto.what_en: Claude uses FluidSim to configure and run Python CFD simulations: set resolution, viscosity and time-step parameters, launch 2D/3D Navier-Stokes, shallow-water or stratified solvers, and plot vorticity, spectra and timeseries.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to run a fluid simulation, pick a solver or review numerical parameters, or when FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics or restart compatibility is involved.
